title: Yogish Profile
content: Yogish Reddy Dwarampudi is a Cloud and DevOps Engineer currently working as an Associate Software Engineer at Accenture. His professional experience focuses on Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD platforms and automation, with experience in Jenkins, CloudBees CI, AWS, Docker and Kubernetes/EKS. His current personal technical focus is expanding his Cloud and DevOps foundation into AI Engineering and Agentic AI. He is interested in building practical products that solve problems and provide users with greater convenience and support.

title: Career Direction
content: Yogish does not consider AI a move away from Cloud and DevOps. He wants to build on his existing Cloud knowledge to create more advanced products using AI and Agentic AI. His current goal is to build systems where a user can provide a single input and an agentic system can complete the intended task with minimal manual work. His long-term goal is to become an engineer who can architect products at a high level, quickly develop an MVP, clearly communicate architecture and capabilities, evaluate security considerations and limitations, and build products capable of serving large numbers of users.

title: Education
content: Yogish completed a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science from NBKR Institute of Science and Technology (NBKRIST), Nellore, from 2020 to 2024, with a final grade of 8.0 out of 10. He completed his MPC higher secondary education at Narayana Junior College, Nellore, from 2018 to 2020.

title: Accenture - Associate Software Engineer - CloudBees CI / Jenkins
content: Company: Accenture. Role: Associate Software Engineer. Joined: September 2024. Current area: CloudBees CI / Jenkins platform. Yogish works as part of a team supporting a large Jenkins platform across approximately 9 lines of business, with 300+ controllers and around 3,000 builds per day. The environment includes managed controllers, Operations Center, static agents running on Windows and Linux VMs, and ephemeral agents provisioned through Kubernetes/EKS using Docker images. Responsibilities and hands-on work include supporting users with Jenkins pipeline troubleshooting, agent selection and connectivity issues, pod-agent memory issues, credentials for GitHub and third-party services such as SonarQube, managed-controller access processes, plugin-version updates, platform-upgrade activities and validation. Platform upgrades are performed quarterly and involve components including Operations Center, agents, plugins and managed controllers. Yogish also uses Jenkins automation jobs for operational reporting and searching build console output for specific information. He participates in risk remediation for software vulnerabilities on Windows and Linux build VMs, validates and updates software where required, and works with Docker base and custom images including quarterly image updates and removal of vulnerable older versions. The team monitors EKS workloads using Datadog and works with AWS backup and restore capabilities including Cloud Native Restore. Other operational activities include license recovery by identifying inactive users and access that can be revoked, and cleanup of inactive controllers and jobs. Yogish uses Jira to track stories and tasks and ServiceNow for service requests and incidents. His work is performed as part of the CloudBees CI team, with senior engineers providing guidance on larger implementations.

title: Accenture Responsibilities
content: As part of the CloudBees CI team, Yogish helps users troubleshoot Jenkins pipeline issues and supports successful pipeline execution. His troubleshooting exposure includes agent selection and connectivity issues, memory-related problems while creating Kubernetes pod agents, adding credentials for GitHub and third-party services such as SonarQube, and managed controller access and access-control processes. He participates in platform upgrades, including quarterly upgrades involving Operations Center, agents, plugins, CJOC and managed controllers. He performs validation activities such as validating agent connectivity and plugin versions during upgrades. He also participates in security risk remediation for Windows and Linux virtual machines used by Jenkins users, including remediation of vulnerabilities in installed software. Yogish uses Jenkins automation jobs for tasks such as searching build console output across CJOC and managed controllers for specific keywords and publishing the resulting data or reports. He works with Docker images used by ephemeral Jenkins agents, including quarterly image updates and removal of older vulnerable versions. He monitors Kubernetes pods in EKS with Datadog and participates in AWS EKS backup and restore activities using cloud-native restore methods. He also works on license recovery activities by identifying inactive users whose platform access can be revoked and helps with cleanup of inactive controllers and jobs. He uses Jira to track stories and tasks and ServiceNow to work with service requests and incidents. He has supported and participated in these activities while working as an Associate Software Engineer, with larger implementations often handled with guidance from senior team members.

title: College Project - Grey Wolf Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networking - Python
content: Project: Grey Wolf Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networking. Type: B.Tech Computer Science college team project. Status: Completed. Team size: 4 students. Objective: Use the Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm to find an efficient path through wireless sensors to reach a receiver, with the goal of reducing latency and cost and improving response time. The approach can avoid inactive or damaged sensors and select an available active sensor path. Yogish's contribution: developed the Python implementation of the Grey Wolf Algorithm. Technology: Python. Tool: Network simulator. The project was developed and tested as a college project.

title: College Website - PHP, MySQL, Student and Parent Portal
content: Project: College Website. Type: College team project. Status: Completed. Purpose: A student and parent portal where authenticated users could access academic and fee-related information. Technologies: PHP and MySQL. Yogish's contribution: worked on the backend used to fetch student records, grades and marks after users logged in with credentials. Features included student details, current academic year, branch information, mid-semester marks, semester marks, semester balance and fee-related information. The project used sample data rather than the college's complete production database. The portal supported both students and parents.

title: AI Portfolio Agent - Next.js, FastAPI, Gemini, RAG
content: Project: AI Portfolio Agent. Type: Personal AI project. Status: Actively evolving production MVP. Purpose: An AI-native personal portfolio that answers questions about Yogish's experience, skills, projects and technical work using grounded personal knowledge. Yogish built and is continuously developing the project. Frontend: Next.js. Backend: FastAPI. AI: Gemini APIs and Gemini embeddings. RAG implementation: knowledge base, document embeddings, cosine-similarity retrieval and retrieved-source information. Additional implementation: conversation history, query rewriting for follow-up questions and streaming responses. Deployment: backend deployed on Render and project maintained through GitHub. Current development includes improving the knowledge base and exploring Gemini Live and voice interaction. The project is actively evolving and is not considered fully completed.

The project is currently focused on establishing the engineering environment and exploring the architecture.

The project is currently in the concept and exploration stage, and its detailed technology stack has not yet been finalized.
